sources.preset: Hole preset of golf_environment/shots_settings.json (par3, par4 or par5). Par 4 (380 m) lets a driver carry of 170 to 250 m land on the fairway; the hole is illustrative, not surveyed.
sources.label: Legend name of the shot; the legend also states the model carry and the side (left or right) from the flight model, never recomputed.
sources.colour_rgba: Trace colour on the fairway green, the first colour of shots_settings.json shot_colours_rgba, chosen there for contrast.
sources.figure: Figure size in inches and resolution that replace the figure block of shots_settings.json: a still of 10 by 6 inches at 130 dpi reads at 1300 by 780 pixels beside the 1280 wide export frames.
